title: API testing with Playwright APIRequestContext
summary: HTTP-клієнт Playwright для Python: playwright.request.new_context з base_url і extra_http_headers, фікстура з yield і dispose(), get / post / put / patch / delete з data і params, APIResponse (status, ok, json(), headers), expect(response).to_be_ok(), fail_on_status_code, пастка зі слешем на початку шляху, коли обирати Playwright API, а коли requests
